posts.title: Teardown of a 1000$ voting machine
posts.description: In Italy, Lombardy spent 24 millions for thousands of voting machines, used them once, then they ended up in the grey market. What’s inside them?

posts.title: Fixing a bit-rotten industrial machine
posts.description: A customer’s industrial machine stopped working due to storage corruption. To get back to a working product, a mixture of pentesting, data recovery and reverse engineering was needed.

posts.title: Hosting a public webcam from the roof of my house
posts.description: The technical details behind streaming a live camera feed to hundreds of concurrent viewers without saturating a 30Mbps uplink, using ffmpeg, HLS, and an Nginx reverse proxy with a simple flag
